st: In season 4, at Wundagore, Bova tells Wanda and Pietro how their mother fled a mutant, left them with her and died, and names Magneto.

files.notes: Family Ties (TAS ep 58; springfield x-men-1992 s04e17). Django says 'Her name was Bova', and on Wundagore 'Bova is right' is said; she tells the story of their mother and names Magneto. She is one of the High Evolutionary's creatures, but the screen never says 'New Men' or any group name, so Independent. Status Missing: the episode ends with Wundagore 'a world created, sustained, then lost', and she is not seen again; switch to Active if a screen check shows her safe. Surname Ayrshire is never said, so n is 'Bova'.

add.k: The big-headed keeper of Sinister's Savage Land devices
st: In season 2, Brainchild chains Magneto and Xavier for his master Sinister, then rushes to save Sinister when Cyclops blasts him apart.

files.notes: Reunion parts 1 and 2 (TAS eps 25 and 26; springfield s02e12, s02e13). He says 'You may call me Brainchild' and 'I am merely the keeper of these devices while the Master is away'; Sinister answers 'Brainchild, that's enough.' In part 2 he cries 'Master! I'll save you, master' after Sinister goes 'all to pieces'. 'My Mutates' and 'those cursed Mutates' are said, so the app's group The Savage Land Mutates.

k: Gambit's old friend serving Magneto on Asteroid M
Gambit's old friend, now with Exodus's Acolytes
st: In season 4, Byron Calley runs Asteroid M's controls for Magneto, then refuses Cortez's order to fire its nuclear missiles at Earth.
In season 2, Byron Calley stands with Exodus's Acolytes in the Savage Land as they put Graydon Creed on trial.

files.notes: Sanctuary parts 1 and 2 (TAS eps 48 and 49; springfield s04e06, s04e07): a protester shouts 'Byron Calley, running off with Magneto'; Gambit: 'Just having a look around, Byron'; Magneto calls him 'Mr. Calley'; Cortez orders him to fire, Gambit says 'Don't listen to him, Byron', and Calley refuses ('But that would wipe out most of the people on Earth!'). 'Acolytes' is never said in Sanctuary and Magneto's asteroid people have no on-screen name, so Independent there. The X-Men '97 step (S2E7 Strange Land, Savage Heart, ep 17) rests on the Marvel Database (his infobox image is from that episode; it says he joined Exodus's Acolytes and witnessed Creed's trial); his name is not said in that transcript, and 'the Acolytes of Magneto' is said there. Drop the '97 step if a screen check does not show him.

add.k: A former Morlock made one of Cortez's Hounds
st: In season 1, he labors as a collared slave on Genosha's dam until the X-Men and Cable set the mutants free.
In season 5, Caliban helps Cortez's Hounds seize Jubilee for Apocalypse, then turns on Cortez to save her, and she forgives him.

files.notes: The Fifth Horseman (TAS ep 71; springfield s05e10): 'Caliban!', 'Caliban would like to look for another vessel', Jubilee: 'Caliban, you don't have to do this' and 'Come on, Caliban, we're going home'. Cortez: 'I drag you out of the Morlock sewers' and 'A Morlock as the vessel'; 'the hounds' are named as Apocalypse's soldiers ('to create the hounds as his personal soldiers'). He turns on the Hounds at the end of the same episode, which a single-title stage cannot show. Season 1 step: Slave Island (ep 7) cameo per the Marvel Database, no lines and no name, so staged n. A Sanctuary cameo (ep 48, Marvel Database 'OnScreenOnly') is not given a step. Separate from the film Caliban the app has. Checker: the Slave Island cameo step was removed as a silent background cameo, like the Sanctuary one.

k: Beast's lawyer at his bail hearing
An adviser to Genosha's mutant-enslaving government
A human remade by the Phalanx as their guide on Earth
st: In season 1, Hodge argues for Beast in court, then advises Genosha's slaving regime until Cable wrecks his getaway car.
In season 5, rebuilt by the Phalanx, Cameron Hodge guides their takeover and holds Wolverine, until Warlock's virus purges them.

files.notes: Enter Magneto (ep 3): the judge says 'Now, Mr. Hodge, you know this court harbors no prejudice' to Beast's lawyer; the Marvel Database treats him as the same man, which the show never explains. Slave Island (ep 7): 'Cameron Hodge. Development adviser to the Government of Genosha'; Cable: 'Have you ever been to Switzerland, Mr. Hodge?' The Phalanx Covenant (eps 67 and 68): 'I'm Cameron Hodge, former liaison to the Genoshan government... Your mutant friends cost me an arm and a leg! Thanks to the Phalanx I've made a complete recovery. In return, I am a kind of guide for their operation on Earth.' His fate after the Phalanx is purged is not shown, so Missing; Hidden Agendas (ep 74) only mentions him ('Hodge was right about the X-Men'), no step. The Cure (ep 9) shows him only in a recap.

add.k: A blind patient whose sight Beast restores
st: In season 2, Carly falls for Beast, who restores her sight, and when the Friends of Humanity kidnap her, Beast storms in to save her.

files.notes: Beauty & the Beast (TAS ep 23; springfield s02e10): 'It's just me, Carly', 'Carly can see', 'The Friends of Humanity kidnapped Carly', and Creed questions her about Beast. Surname Crocker is never said, so n is 'Carly'. A patient, not staff, so not in Beast's hospital group. A photo of her in Dark Phoenix part 3 is not an appearance.

add.k: A comatose hero whose powers and mind Rogue took
st: In season 2, Ms. Marvel's buried psyche fights Rogue from within until Jean merges their minds, and Rogue then names her Carol Danvers.

files.notes: A Rogue's Tale (TAS ep 22; springfield s02e09): 'It's Miss Marvel! That's Ms. Marvel to you, round boy!' in Rogue's memory, the psyche cries 'Ms. Marvel is reborn!', and at the end Rogue tells the nurse 'Her name is Carol Danvers.' Her body is still in a coma at the end with her vital signs stirring; Active is the nearest status. A Marvel Database 'OnScreenOnly' cameo in Love in Vain (ep 45) is not given a step. Separate from the MCU Carol Danvers.

add.k: A reptilian crewman of Corsair's Starjammers
st: In season 3, Ch'od flies and fires the Starjammer for Corsair against D'Ken's forces, then warns Corsair off course from Shi'ar police.

files.notes: The Phoenix Saga parts 4 and 5 (eps 32 and 33; springfield s03e06, s03e07): Corsair orders 'Ch'od, get the Starjammer out of here', 'Ch'od, full magnification', 'Ch'od, open fire!'. Orphan's End (ep 44; s03e16): 'CH'OD: Corsair, sorry to break communications silence, but I strongly suggest you alter your course 13 degrees to the north.' 'They are intergalactic pirates who call themselves the Starjammers' is said.

add.k: One of Solarr's henchmen in Skull Mesa
st: In season 4, Chet Lambert backs his boss Braddock in Skull Mesa and drags Cyclops out to be burned, until the town rises against them.

files.notes: Secrets, Not Long Buried (TAS ep 52; springfield s04e15): Braddock keeps asking 'Isn't that right, Chet?' ('Right, Mr. Braddock', 'Yes. Yep.') and orders 'Lambert! Toad! Take him to the center of town!' The townsfolk say they will deal with Solarr and his men themselves, so In custody. The Marvel Database's 'Children of the Shadow' is not said in the transcript, so Independent. A Graduation Day cameo (ep 76, Marvel Database 'OnScreenOnly') is not given a step.

add.k: Wolverine's old comrade from a secret ops unit
st: In season 4, Maverick and Silver Fox lure Wolverine and Sabretooth to the lab that altered their memories, then fight its robot Talos.
In season 2, Maverick joins Wolverine's raid on a Weapon X lab overrun by the Brood, where the infected Wolverine kills him.

files.notes: Weapon X, Lies, and Video Tape (TAS ep 61; springfield s03e19): 'Silver Fox, Maverick, you're alive!', 'Maverick, scan the area!', 'MAVERICK: Power source is buried pretty deep'. X-Men '97 S2E5 Weapon X, Lies, and DVDs (ep 15; springfield x-men-97-2024 s02e05): 'Maverick and Kane are old Weapon X bosom buddies', 'Once Team X, always Team X, right?', and after the attack someone says 'That's not Logan. Maverick is dead.' 'Team X' is said in '97; in TAS the unit is not named in the transcript, but the app already keys Sabretooth's TAS group to Team X. Seen only in visions or memories in Deadly Reunions (ep 4), Red Dawn (ep 17), Out of the Past (ep 27) and Lotus and the Steel (ep 60), not given steps. Real name not said.

add.k: A loud-mouthed Nasty Boy with a deafening sonic scream
st: In season 2, Ruckus wrecks Cyclops and Jean's honeymoon boat for Sinister, then guards Sinister's Savage Land lair from the X-Men.
In season 4, Ruckus helps the Nasty Boys snatch Jean from her wedding for Sinister and later fights the X-Men in Apocalypse's lair.

files.notes: Till Death Do Us Part part 2 (ep 15; s02e02): 'RUCKUS: Ahoy! On the sailboat!', 'That's because you never heard Ruckus raise a ruckus before!'. Reunion (eps 25 and 26; s02e12, s02e13): Sinister: 'Ruckus, get Jean Grey to the plane!'; X-Men: 'We took you apart once, Ruckus'. Beyond Good and Evil parts 1 and 4 (eps 63 and 66; s04e08, s04e11): Gambit: 'It's Ruckus', 'The Nasty Boys got Jean and Cyclops!', Sinister: 'Ruckus, Vertigo, Hairbag, move it!', and '(RUCKUS SCREAMING) Ruckus has a way with words'. A Sanctuary cameo (ep 48) is not a separate step. Real name not said.

k: Rogue's first boyfriend, drained by her first kiss
Rogue's first boyfriend, taken over by alien spores
st: In season 1, young Cody kisses Rogue under the moon and collapses as her powers drain him.
In season 3, a Colony-infected Cody lures Rogue away to be made a host, then stays behind with the aliens when she escapes.

files.notes: The Cure (ep 9; s01e09): 'CODY: The moon sure is pretty tonight. You ever been kissed, girl?' then Rogue: 'Cody!' (flashback). Love in Vain (ep 45; springfield s04e14): 'Cody? How on Earth did you find me?', 'So that's Cody?', 'Rogue, we could be together', and at the end 'Let him go! He's one of them now.' The aliens call themselves 'the colony' on screen ('a strong addition to the colony'); 'Brood' is not said in TAS, so The Colony (the app's Brood file comes from X-Men '97). Surname Robbins not said. Status Missing: he is left aboard the aliens' living ship. A Rogue's Tale (ep 22) reuses the kiss footage only.

st: In season 4, Darrell Tanaka drives the stranded Cyclops to Skull Mesa, treats his head and at last stands with him against Solarr.

files.notes: Secrets, Not Long Buried (TAS ep 52; springfield s04e15): 'I'm Darrell Tanaka.', 'Doctor and coroner. In a town this small, people tend to do double duty', Cyclops: 'All right, Tanaka! I want some answers!' and 'How can you call yourself a doctor? How, indeed?' Skull Mesa is a town, not an organization, so Independent. That he joins the final stand rests on the Marvel Database (he heals Cyclops so his powers return); the transcript has no speaker tag for that moment.

add.k: The man who raised Wanda and Pietro
st: In season 4, from his hospital bed, Django tells Wanda and Pietro he is not their real father and sends them to find the midwife Bova.

files.notes: Family Ties (TAS ep 58; springfield s04e17): 'Marya and I raised you as our own, we are not your natural parents... brought to our home by a midwife. Her name was Bova'; the twins tell Bova 'Django said you knew our natural parents.' Surname Maximoff is not said for him. The Marvel Database marks him as dying, but on screen he says 'I shall be fine, children', so Active.

add.k: A mutant thug of Mystique's who makes the ground quake
st: In season 1, Avalanche brawls with Rogue on Muir Island, then wreaks havoc at Senator Kelly's hearing as Mystique's diversion.
In season 2, Avalanche raids a farmers' market with Pyro and Blob, then fights the X-Men at the hospital where Mystique awaits Rogue.

files.notes: The Cure (ep 9; s01e09): Pyro: 'Cody Avalanche! Avalanche!' and the Muir Island fight. Days of Future Past part 2 (ep 12; s01e12): 'Shall we begin the diversion, Avalanche, old darling?', 'Give it to them straight up, Avalanche!' A Rogue's Tale (ep 22; s02e09): 'Nice work, Avalanche, old stick.' Also a Slave Island cameo (ep 7) per the Marvel Database. 'Brotherhood' is not in these transcripts; the app already files Mystique and her gang as The Brotherhood, so that name is used; switch to Independent if the screen never says it. Real name not said.

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Long ago Bova brought the newborn twins to Django and Marya and swore them to silence. From his hospital bed, Django tells Wanda and Pietro about her and sends them to find her on Wundagore.
stages.whoA: Django, the man she gave the twins to raise
stages.whoB: Bova, the midwife who brought him the twins

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Brainchild keeps Sinister's devices in the Savage Land while his master is away and greets him with joy. When Cyclops blasts Sinister to pieces, Brainchild cries out that he will save his master.
stages.whoA: Mister Sinister, the master he serves
stages.whoB: Brainchild, the Mutate who keeps his devices

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Brainchild's Mutates capture Magneto in the Savage Land and Brainchild has him chained to the wall for Sinister. The X-Men later free him.
stages.whoA: Magneto, a captive he chains for Sinister
stages.whoB: Brainchild, the Mutate who chains him up

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Brainchild takes Xavier along with Magneto and holds them for Sinister. Sinister then shows off a device that drains the powers of every mutant in the Savage Land.
stages.whoA: Professor X, a captive he holds for Sinister
stages.whoB: Brainchild, the Mutate who holds him

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Both serve Sinister in the Savage Land. Brainchild minds Sinister's devices while Ruckus and the Nasty Boys fight the X-Men.
stages.whoA: Ruckus, a fellow servant of Sinister
stages.whoB: Brainchild, a fellow servant of Sinister

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: On Asteroid M, Byron greets Remy as an old friend and asks when he signed up. When Cortez orders the missiles fired, Gambit urges Byron not to listen, and Byron refuses.
stages.whoA: Remy, his old friend
stages.whoB: Byron, an old friend serving on Asteroid M

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Byron runs Asteroid M's systems for Magneto, reporting on the NASA shuttle and cloaking the asteroid at his order. He refuses to go along when Cortez takes over.
stages.whoA: Magneto, who runs Asteroid M
stages.whoB: Mr. Calley, one of his crew on Asteroid M

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: With Magneto gone, Cortez orders Byron to arm and launch the asteroid's missiles at Earth. Byron refuses and tries to stop him, and Cortez turns on him as a traitor.
stages.whoA: Cortez, who orders him to fire on Earth
stages.whoB: Byron Calley, who refuses his order

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Caliban helps the Hounds capture Jubilee as a vessel for Apocalypse, but he protects her from harm. He offers himself in her place, turns on Cortez, and Jubilee forgives him and takes him home.
stages.whoA: Jubilee, the girl he turns on Cortez to save
stages.whoB: Caliban, the Hound who saves her

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Cortez dragged Caliban out of the Morlock sewers and made him one of Apocalypse's Hounds. When Caliban asks to spare Jubilee and offers himself instead, Cortez mocks him and turns him back to his old self.
stages.whoA: Cortez, who made him a Hound
stages.whoB: Caliban, one of his Hounds

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Hodge argues for Beast at his bail hearing. The judge denies bail anyway.
stages.whoA: Beast, his client at a bail hearing
stages.whoB: Hodge, his lawyer at his bail hearing

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Hodge returns as the Phalanx's guide on Earth. Beast's team confronts him in the Phalanx core, and Beast helps Warlock purge the Phalanx.
stages.whoA: Beast, who fights the Phalanx
stages.whoB: Cameron Hodge, the Phalanx's human guide

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Hodge tells Gyrich that Cable was a mercenary who turned on the Leader. Cable then catches Hodge and the Leader fleeing Genosha and wrecks their car.
stages.whoA: Cable, the rebel who wrecks his escape
stages.whoB: Hodge, Genosha's adviser

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: On Genosha, Hodge warns Trask that Master Mold drew too much power. They work together for the slaving regime.
stages.whoA: Trask, who builds Genosha's Sentinels
stages.whoB: Hodge, Genosha's development adviser

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Hodge briefs Gyrich on Genosha and explains who Cable is. Both back the regime's Sentinel program.
stages.whoA: Gyrich, who visits Genosha
stages.whoB: Hodge, Genosha's adviser

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Hodge holds the captured Wolverine and says the Phalanx will use his adamantium to learn to absorb mutants. Wolverine vows to carve his tombstone.
stages.whoA: Wolverine, his captive
stages.whoB: Cameron Hodge, the Phalanx's guide

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: The Phalanx rebuilt Hodge's lost arm and leg, and in return he guides their work on Earth. He reports on their slow progress absorbing mutants.
stages.whoA: The Phalanx, who rebuilt him
stages.whoB: Cameron Hodge, their human guide on Earth

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Hank cares for Carly at the eye hospital and the two fall in love. He restores her sight, and she is happy to see him at last. When the Friends of Humanity take her, he storms their base to save her.
stages.whoA: Hank McCoy, the doctor she loves
stages.whoB: Carly, the patient he loves

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Creed has his Friends of Humanity kidnap Carly for being close to a mutant. He tells her all mutants and their friends must be wiped out, until Wolverine and Beast break in.
stages.whoA: Graydon Creed, who has her kidnapped
stages.whoB: Carly, the woman he takes

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Wolverine poses as a bigot to get inside the Friends of Humanity. He finds Carly held there and helps Beast get her out.
stages.whoA: Wolverine, who helps rescue her
stages.whoB: Carly, the woman he helps rescue

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Long ago, on Mystique's order, Rogue grabbed Ms. Marvel and absorbed her mind and powers, leaving her in a coma. Her psyche rises inside Rogue to fight her until Jean merges their minds. Rogue later visits her bed and names her Carol Danvers.
stages.whoA: Rogue, who stole her life
stages.whoB: Ms. Marvel, whose mind and powers she took

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Ms. Marvel stops Mystique's plane theft, and Mystique has Rogue hold on to her until she falls. Mystique later stirs up Ms. Marvel's buried memories to win Rogue back.
stages.whoA: Mystique, the foe who had her drained
stages.whoB: Ms. Marvel, a hero who foiled her

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Ch'od crews the Starjammer under Corsair, flying, scanning and firing at his orders against D'Ken. Later he breaks radio silence to steer Corsair clear of the Shi'ar police.
stages.whoA: Corsair, his captain
stages.whoB: Ch'od, one of his Starjammers crew

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Ch'od fires on D'Ken's Imperial Guard as the Starjammers fight to stop the Emperor seizing the M'Kraan Crystal.
stages.whoA: D'Ken, the Emperor the Starjammers fight
stages.whoB: Ch'od, one of the rebel Starjammers

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Chet backs Braddock's lies when Cyclops asks after Dr. Prescott. On Braddock's order he and Toad drag Cyclops to the town square to be burned, until the townsfolk turn on them.
stages.whoA: Cyclops, the outsider he helps attack
stages.whoB: Chet Lambert, one of Solarr's men

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Maverick and Silver Fox, thought dead, draw Logan back to the old lab to learn who changed their memories. They fight off Talos together.
stages.whoA: Logan, his old teammate
stages.whoB: Maverick, his old teammate

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Wolverine recruits Maverick for a raid on a Weapon X lab. Infected by the Brood, Wolverine kills him.
stages.whoA: Logan, who recruits him, then kills him
stages.whoB: Maverick, an old teammate he kills

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Maverick and Silver Fox accuse Creed of leaving them to die. They still team up against Talos, and Wolverine has Maverick give Sabretooth a blaster.
stages.whoA: Sabretooth, the teammate who left him to die
stages.whoB: Maverick, a teammate he left behind

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Sabretooth rejoins Maverick in Logan's old crew for the raid. They search the ruined lab together until Maverick is killed.
stages.whoA: Sabretooth, back in the old crew
stages.whoB: Maverick, back in the old crew

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Beast comes with Wolverine to the old lab and helps Maverick and the others fight Talos.
stages.whoA: Dr. McCoy, who comes with Wolverine
stages.whoB: Maverick, Wolverine's old comrade

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Morph joins Maverick on Wolverine's raid, and they search the facility. Morph calls for Wolverine and Maverick when the creatures attack.
stages.whoA: Morph, Wolverine's friend on the raid
stages.whoB: Maverick, part of Wolverine's crew

stages.title: X-Men '97
stages.text: Yuriko and Maverick are both in Wolverine's old crew. They search the lab together until the infected Wolverine kills him.
stages.whoA: Yuriko, a teammate on the raid
stages.whoB: Maverick, a teammate killed on the raid

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Ruckus and the Nasty Boys capture Cyclops and Jean on their honeymoon for Sinister and later guard his Savage Land lair.
stages.whoA: Mister Sinister, his boss
stages.whoB: Ruckus, one of his Nasty Boys

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Sinister's Nasty Boys snatch Jean from her wedding, and Sinister orders Ruckus and the others to move out.
stages.whoA: Mister Sinister, his boss
stages.whoB: Ruckus, one of his Nasty Boys

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Ruckus wrecks Cyclops and Jean's honeymoon boat with his scream and takes them to Sinister. He fights the X-Men again in the Savage Land.
stages.whoA: Cyclops, a captive and foe
stages.whoB: Ruckus, one of Sinister's Nasty Boys

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Ruckus and the Nasty Boys crash Cyclops and Jean's wedding and leave Cyclops behind as they take Jean.
stages.whoA: Cyclops, whose wedding he crashes
stages.whoB: Ruckus, a Nasty Boy who crashes his wedding

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Ruckus knocks out Jean on her honeymoon for Sinister, and later Sinister orders him to get her to the plane.
stages.whoA: Jean Grey, a captive for Sinister
stages.whoB: Ruckus, a Nasty Boy who captures her

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: The Nasty Boys take Jean from her wedding through a portal for Sinister.
stages.whoA: Jean Grey, taken from her wedding
stages.whoB: Ruckus, one of her kidnappers

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Ruckus's scream pains Wolverine's sharp hearing on Sinister's island, and the X-Men later face him again in the Savage Land.
stages.whoA: Wolverine, a foe on Sinister's island
stages.whoB: Ruckus, a loud Nasty Boy

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Rogue's first kiss with Cody drains him and leaves him collapsed.
stages.whoA: Rogue, his first girlfriend
stages.whoB: Cody, her first boyfriend

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Cody finds Rogue again and she can touch him at last, but he is working for the alien colony that wants her as a host. She chooses to escape and leaves him with the aliens.
stages.whoA: Rogue, the girl he lures to the colony
stages.whoB: Cody, the boyfriend she must leave behind

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Gambit sulks when Rogue takes time off to spend with Cody. He fights the colony to get her back.
stages.whoA: Gambit, who resents him
stages.whoB: Cody, the boyfriend he resents

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Tanaka drives the stranded Scott into Skull Mesa and treats his head. At first too afraid to help, he finally stands with Cyclops against Solarr.
stages.whoA: Scott Summers, a stranger he helps
stages.whoB: Darrell Tanaka, the town doctor

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Mystique calls Avalanche and Pyro to Muir Island, and they later carry out her plot at Senator Kelly's hearing.
stages.whoA: Mystique, his leader
stages.whoB: Avalanche, one of her gang

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Avalanche's gang raids a market and then guards the hospital where Mystique waits to win Rogue back.
stages.whoA: Mystique, his leader
stages.whoB: Avalanche, one of her gang

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Avalanche joins Pyro's pub fight with Rogue on Muir Island, and she throws him into the sea. They later grab the fake Dr. Adler, and Rogue knocks them out.
stages.whoA: Rogue, who throws him into the sea
stages.whoB: Avalanche, a Brotherhood thug

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Rogue remembers working with Mystique's gang, then fights Avalanche and the others in the present.
stages.whoA: Rogue, a former ally turned foe
stages.whoB: Avalanche, a former partner in Mystique's gang

stages.title: X-Men: The Animated Series
stages.text: Bishop absorbs Avalanche's seismic power at Senator Kelly's hearing and throws it back, driving the gang off.
stages.whoA: Bishop, who turns his quake back on him
stages.whoB: Avalanche, a mutant at the hearing
